description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, scenario-based MCQ prompts for medical education, including instructions, explanation templates, and example questions.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based MCQs based on difficulty, context, and content type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring criteria.
